_doc: Global skill registry + project-type bundles (mission 2026-07-05). Skills auto-attach: every agent gets its CORE skills (agent-skill-map.json) + the bundle matching the detected project type — no manual reconnection per project. 'kind' says where a skill actually lives, so a fresh machine (no ~/.claude/skills, no ECC, no plugins — see the perspective rule) never expects one that is not there. Kind values: 'vendored' = ships inside this project's .claude/skills/<name> (see .claude/skills/VENDORED-SKILLS.md), always present; 'forge-playbook' = ships inside this project's .claude/skills/forge-*; 'method' = a documented procedure inside a playbook/agent, not a standalone SKILL.md; 'ecc/plugin' and 'ecc-agent' = optional, from the owner's separately-installed ECC toolkit/plugins (may be absent); 'external/optional' = a genuinely global (~/.claude/skills) skill this project does not ship — a fresh machine will not have it, so a 'fallback' field names what Forge does instead. Codex-recheck 2026-09-26 (N9/D — laptop re-audit): 11 entries were tagged 'global' while only 3 of them (test-driven-development, systematic-debugging, brainstorming) actually ship vendored in this project; the other 11 unique names never ship and are now 'external/optional' with an honest fallback. If a required skill is still missing at runtime → Skill Boss reports it + uses the labeled fallback (never silently skip, never claim a skill loaded that did not).
